name: test-explorer-for-unity
description: Run Unity Edit Mode and Play Mode tests from the VS Code Testing tab, with the Editor staying usable while they run, or in an optional background worker.

commands.title: Unity Tests: Install or Update the Test Bridge

unityTests.enableWorker.description: Adds Run in Worker, which runs tests in a headless Unity and keeps your Editor free. It keeps a copy of your project in a folder next to it, roughly the same size as the project.

unityTests.maxTestsPerRun.description: With the worker enabled, ask where to run when a run has more tests than this. 0 removes the limit.

unityTests.slowTestSeconds.description: Ask before running a test in the open Editor if it took at least this many seconds last time. [Explicit] tests ask until they've run once. 0 asks only for [Explicit] tests.

unityTests.sourceGlob.description: Files searched to link tests to their source. Empty finds them from your test assembly definitions.
